title: Golden Hour Ambient Sunlight
description: Low-angle warm directional sunlight occurring shortly after sunrise or before sunset, characterized by soft diffused highlights, elongated dramatic shadows, and golden chromatic warmth.

title: Chiaroscuro and Rembrant Lighting
description: High-contrast chiaroscuro with bold transitions between bright highlights and deep tenebrous shadows. Rembrandt lighting features a characteristic illuminated triangle under the cheek on the shadow side.

title: Volumetric God Rays and Atmospheric Light
description: Visible light shafts scattering through mist, fog, haze, or particulate air (crepuscular rays/Tyndall effect), creating three-dimensional spatial depth and atmospheric luminescence.

title: Rim Light and Edge Separation
description: Backlighting positioned behind the subject creating a luminous outline rim along edges and hair, cleanly separating the foreground silhouette or subject from dark backgrounds.

title: Studio Softbox and Diffused Fill
description: Evenly dispersed, soft-edged wraparound illumination from large parabolic octaboxes or diffusers, eliminating harsh specular reflections and producing flattering portraits.

title: Cyberpunk Neon and Dual-Tone Light
description: Vibrant chromatic contrast utilizing complementary neon tones (such as cyan and magenta, or amber and teal) reflecting across wet asphalt and reflective metallic surfaces.
